pli-tv-bi-vb-pc91:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhuniyo sikkhamānāya ummaddāpentipi parimaddāpentipi …pe… sāmaṇerāya
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc93:1.2: manussā vihāracārikaṃ āhiṇḍantā passitvā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc93:1.3: “kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo gihīniyā ummaddāpessantipi parimaddāpessantipi seyyathāpi gihī kāmabhoginiyo”ti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc93:1.4: assosuṃ kho bhikkhuniyo tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc93:1.5: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc93:1.6: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo gihīniyā ummaddāpessantipi, parimaddāpessantipī”ti. …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc93:1.7: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave, bhikkhuniyo gihīniyā ummaddāpentipi parimaddāpentipīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc93:1.10: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhave, bhikkhuniyo gihīniyā ummaddāpentipi parimaddāpentipi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc93:1.12: evañca pana bhikkhave, bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc93:1.13.1: “yā pana bhikkhunī sikkhamānāya …pe… sāmaṇerāya …pe… gihīniyā ummaddāpeyya vā parimaddāpeyya vā, pācittiya”nti.
